parameters.name: DBInstanceName
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB-X instance whose column store audit logs you want to query.

parameters.name: MaxResultRows
parameters.description: The maximum number of result rows to return for this request. Valid values: 1 to 10000. If this parameter is not specified, no additional row limit is applied to the SQL statement submitted by the caller. The result is still subject to the server-side SSE upper limit of 10000 rows and the top-level LIMIT clause in the SQL statement.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the request. The value must match the region where the SQLQuery service is deployed.

parameters.name: SQL
parameters.description: The read-only query statement to execute. Only a single MySQL SELECT statement is supported. The query table must use the fully qualified form polardbx_sls.<table_name>, and only the following tables are allowed: polardbx_sls.polardbx_log (kernel logs), polardbx_sls.slow_detail_log (slow query logs), polardbx_sls.slow_trans_log (slow transaction logs), and polardbx_sls.sql_audit_log (audit logs). Multi-statement queries, write operations, locks, user variables, dynamic placeholders, and reserved hints are not supported.
